Programme overview

Bachelor of Physiotherapy

Focuses on physical therapy and rehabilitation techniques.

Study includes physical rehabilitation, exercise therapy and the treatment of physical disorders.

What the programme covers

Academic focus.

Physical therapy
Rehabilitation techniques
Exercise therapy
Treatment of physical disorders
Mobility and functional recovery

Practical learning

Knowledge connected with practice.

The programme connects physical therapy and rehabilitation knowledge with exercise-based practice.

Internship

Structured practical exposure.

Internship included within the 4.5-year programme duration.

Career context

Professional direction.

The programme prepares students to support mobility, rehabilitation and quality of life.
